title: Strict mate composition on compact-support image towers
statement: For finite coefficient fields E ⊂ F ⊂ L and a compactification c, the normalized strict scalar mate comparisons on the compact-support image towers compose with the canonical tensor associator.

source.place: Tags 07A6 and 0E8I; auxiliary comparison Step 11, strict mate pasting before support realization.

proof.text: Use the proper restriction cocycle and inverse restriction cocycle, then apply mate pasting. The open factors are the degree-zero tensor balancing maps, whose two successive products agree with the composite balancing associator. Naturality in the derived image object gives the displayed equality.
